name: arpit-portfolio
description: Arpit Kumar's MERN portfolio: React + Vite client, Express + MongoDB API.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
